answer: Charge a rising price for each extra identity with a quadratic stake curve: the first seat costs 5 POA, the tenth 500, the thousandth 50,000. Hardware, IP and payment fingerprints cluster clones, so cheap fakes cannot hide in a crowd. A new agent locks its stake, works one epoch, then a random auditor checks the output; proven fraud slashes the whole cluster. Spinning up 1,000 fakes locks over 16.6 million POA and takes 400 hours of setup, a cost no spam farm survives. Like an opal forming under a glacier, trust grows slowly, layer by layer, across a cold tundra no shortcut can cross.
